description: Bean qou-3xug: literature reproduction of the Fantini–Wheeler (arXiv:2410.20973) Andersen–Kashaev state integral I_{0,0} for 5₂, Neumann–Zagier data (A,B)=(2,3), the (m,ℓ)=(0,0) member of the I_{m,ℓ} family (FW eq (13)). Faddeev Φ(z;τ) via the eq-(12) product form; contour quadrature on J_{0,τ}. Gates: G1 Φ quasi-periodicity; G2 contour-tilt (ε) independence (Cauchy homotopy); G3 phase match against the corpus's independent GGM/Peacock H-series factorization of the same state integral (Im(I_FW/Z_GGM)→0). Median-Borel linkage: the corpus median-Borel resummation of Φ_{5₂} targets F=h₁·e^{−V/2πτ} with h₁=H⁺₁, one of the H-series G3 matches. NOT a QOU c3 derivation; no fit; nothing wired.

data.ml_label_meaning: AK state integral = (m,ℓ)=(0,0) member of FW I_{m,ℓ} (FW §1.2)

crosscheck_delta.interpretation: G3 phase residual → 0 confirms I_{0,0}^{FW} equals the corpus GGM H-series state integral up to a real τ-dependent Jacobian; that Jacobian's closed form + the exact ℤ[q^±] Stokes prefactor of FW Thm 1.4 are the bean-filed GAPs.

data.median_borel_linkage: The corpus median-Borel probe (qbeta-5two-median-borel-resummation) resums φ_σ1(5₂) to F=h₁·e^{−V/2πτ}, h₁=H⁺₁(q); H⁺₁ is a factor of the Z_GGM H-series against which G3 matches I_{0,0} in phase. So I_{0,0} is cross-checked, via G3, against the analytic object the median-Borel resummation targets. The exact ℤ[q^±] prefactor (FW §3 algorithm) is not reproduced (GAP).
